description: Provides provider-neutral discovery, normalization, validation, and execution building blocks for REST, GraphQL, and OpenAPI data sources.
purpose: Give independently deployable consumers a canonical way to describe and operate API data sources without coupling their application logic to one transport or provider.

exports.name: createFlowApiOperationOwner
exports.description:
Projects one server-resolved API operation into a credential-free Flow capability descriptor.

The projection retains only typed public declarations. It never copies unclassified metadata,
URLs, credentials, defaults, headers, cookies, or executable values.

exports.description:
Create the portable Zefix PublicREST descriptor for company search and UID lookup.

this API definition or in a client bundle.

exports.name: mapZefixCompanyResult
exports.description:
Map one Zefix company DTO into a portable, provenance-preserving acquisition result.

The returned `wire` object is the provider record and remains distinct from the curated
`company` projection. Manual CRM contacts, activities, follow-ups, and user-entered fields are
intentionally absent: they must be stored by their application owner, not mixed with Zefix data.
